name: Highcairn
summary: An outdoor clothing store with live ridge hero, trip planner, checkout and a full owner dashboard
about: A complete online store for a technical outdoor brand, with parallax mountain ridges, wind-blown snow and a climber who plants a flag on the summit. Shoppers filter the range, pick colours and sizes from live stock, build a kit with the trip planner and check out in PKR. The owner dashboard runs the shop: revenue charts, orders with status timelines, stock per size, new products and promo codes that work in the bag straight away.
how: Browse the home page: the climber climbs the ridge, and the trip planner turns a destination and month into a three-layer kit you can add in one tap.
Open the shop to filter by category, gender, size in stock, colour, price and waterproofing, then sort; cards glide into their new places.
On a product, choose a colour (the jacket recolours) and an in-stock size, then add it: the item flies into the bag and the badge bounces.
In the bag change quantities, remove lines, apply the code SUMMIT10 and pick delivery; at checkout fill the validated form and place the order.
Open Admin to see the new order arrive, move it through Packed, Shipped and Delivered, edit stock per size, add products and create promo codes.
With reduced motion the wipes, snow, flights and confetti are skipped, and every function still works.
